definitions: A strip of plastic, metal, or wood with a row of narrow teeth, used for untangling or arranging hair.
A fleshy, red outgrowth on the head of a domestic fowl, especially a rooster.
A structure of hexagonal cells made by bees, used to store honey and pollen and house their larvae.
examples: She ran a comb through her tangled hair.
The rooster had a large red comb.
The beekeeper carefully removed a section of the honeycomb.
